# Daily AI Native Product Radar - 2026-09-24

数据窗口：2026-09-21T00:00:00Z to 2026-09-24T03:58:00Z；GitHub Search API 查询最近创建或活跃更新的 AI agent、MCP、browser/computer-use、code-agent、RAG/LLM app、assistant、workflow automation 等方向，并对 42 个候选做 repository/root/README audit。

信息来源：Queried 6 GitHub Search API surfaces saved under /tmp/radar_2026_09_24_api/. Deduplicated 72 repositories from created-since and pushed-since searches, then audited 42 shortlisted repositories through GitHub repository/root/README API saved under /tmp/radar_2026_09_24_readmes/. Selection prioritized product-shaped AI agent, computer-use, MCP, RAG, browser automation, documentation QA, and IDE assistant surfaces with runnable CLI/UI/API evidence, tests, examples, package metadata, Docker/config files, screenshots, or explicit safety boundaries.

关键假设：Scores are based on live GitHub Search API metadata and selected repository/root/README audits. No third-party repository was cloned, installed, built, run, browser-tested, desktop-tested, Visual-Studio-tested, credential-tested, provider-tested, phone-tested, security-tested, MCP-connected, or deployed locally. Star/fork counts are raw GitHub metadata at collection time and can move quickly for new repositories. Mature projects found only through pushed activity and repositories with sensitive automation were downgraded unless this window showed a distinct, bounded product signal.

## 今日趋势观察

Today's strongest signal is the migration of AI-native tooling into local control surfaces: macOS accessibility computer-use, text-first desktop control, Visual Studio/Copilot orchestration, browser-test generation, and documentation drift repair. Jev/Laya-style typed decisions are becoming a reusable primitive for browser fields, test selection, and form filling, but the radar should keep separating complete workflow products from thin model demos. Vertical RAG continues to look credible when it ships evidence views, sanitized sample data, or concrete domain routing rather than another generic chat shell.

## Top Projects

### 1. [FluidInference/FluidUse](https://github.com/FluidInference/FluidUse)
- 分类：Local Apple-silicon computer use
- AI Native Product Score：91
- 做什么：Swift package for local computer-use on Apple silicon that reads macOS Accessibility forms, uses small on-device decision models, and types into real apps.
- 面向谁：Developers building private local assistants that need fast form filling without sending screen or field data to a cloud model.
- AI native 点：Moves computer-use from screenshot-heavy remote reasoning toward millisecond local typed decisions over accessibility state.
- 增长/活跃信号：Pushed 2026-09-23 with 152 stars. Root audit found Package.swift, Sources, Tests, Tools, Documentation, Benchmarks, Media, and Core ML decision-model docs.
- 可运行性判断：High from Swift package structure, tests, benchmarks, tools, media, and documentation; no macOS Accessibility session, model download, or form fill was executed.
- 建议动作：Test only on disposable local forms first and inspect Accessibility permissions plus readback behavior before using real applications.

### 2. [openqa-cn/jev-browser](https://github.com/openqa-cn/jev-browser)
- 分类：Indexed browser automation skill
- AI Native Product Score：89
- 做什么：Standalone CodexQA skill that turns browser pages into multiple-choice control decisions, with Playwright action execution, cases, docs, examples, tests, and bilingual READMEs.
- 面向谁：QA and coding-agent builders who want cheaper, more bounded browser checks after code changes.
- AI native 点：Separates browser perception from action: Jev selects indexed controls while Playwright performs the operation and tests verify outcomes.
- 增长/活跃信号：Pushed 2026-09-23 with 93 stars. Root audit found .env.example, SKILL.md, agents, bin, cases, docs, examples, knowledge, src, tests, and Vitest config.
- 可运行性判断：Medium-high from package/tests/examples/cases; no Jev account, Playwright task, or CodexQA skill install was run.
- 建议动作：Compare against screenshot-based browser QA on one deterministic page and track wrong-control rate, latency, and failure explanation quality.

### 3. [anthonyli/laya-pilot](https://github.com/anthonyli/laya-pilot)
- 分类：Browser-to-Excel test generation
- AI Native Product Score：88
- 做什么：Playwright automation tool that generates replayable Excel test cases from live browser pages or executes existing Excel cases using local Laya or compatible decision APIs.
- 面向谁：QA teams that need agent-assisted test authoring but still want reviewable, spreadsheet-shaped artifacts.
- AI native 点：Turns ambiguous browser exploration into replayable test cases and keeps assertion pass/fail tied to page state rather than model claims.
- 增长/活跃信号：Pushed 2026-09-23 with 26 stars. Root audit found .env.example, config example, docs, examples, lib, runner, worker, public demo scripts, requirements, and tests.
- 可运行性判断：Medium-high from demo scripts, package files, docs, examples, and tests; no browser page, Laya model, or Excel replay was executed.
- 建议动作：Run the included demo server and inspect whether generated Excel cases are understandable enough for non-agent QA review.

### 4. [pagebeam/pagebeam](https://github.com/pagebeam/pagebeam)
- 分类：AI documentation drift repair
- AI Native Product Score：87
- 做什么：Open-source package and GitHub Action that checks documentation pages against the product they describe, reports confidence, and drafts pull requests with fixes.
- 面向谁：Product and developer-documentation teams whose UI or API changes faster than docs.
- AI native 点：Frames documentation as an agent-verifiable product surface with repository-native checks and repair PRs.
- 增长/活跃信号：Pushed 2026-09-23 with 7 stars. Root audit found action.yml, examples, packages, package metadata, TypeScript configs, changelog, and docs-oriented README.
- 可运行性判断：Medium-high from npm command surface and GitHub Action metadata; no app/docs repository, browser check, or PR draft was run.
- 建议动作：Trial on a small docs page with a known stale UI claim and require human review on every proposed fix.

### 5. [Sur-Cai/macos-computer-use-kit](https://github.com/Sur-Cai/macos-computer-use-kit)
- 分类：AX-first macOS computer-use MCP
- AI Native Product Score：86
- 做什么：Python CLI, MCP server, skill, and plugin package for controlling macOS apps through accessibility-tree targeting, guarded inputs, and read-back verification.
- 面向谁：Agent users on macOS who want local app control without cursor movement or screenshot-only coordinate guessing.
- AI native 点：Packages accessibility-tree observations, semantic guards, and verification as reusable computer-use primitives for agents.
- 增长/活跃信号：Pushed 2026-09-23 with 4 stars. Root audit found PyPI-style package metadata, install script, packages, plugins, skill, src, tests, tools, and bilingual README.
- 可运行性判断：Medium-high from CLI/package/tests/plugin structure; no macOS permissions, MCP server, DeepSeek Harness plugin, or app action was run.
- 建议动作：Evaluate with a harmless native app workflow and verify that destructive actions require explicit guarding and readback.

### 6. [I-No-oNe/screenpeek](https://github.com/I-No-oNe/screenpeek)
- 分类：Text-first desktop app control
- AI Native Product Score：85
- 做什么：Rust tool that scans desktop apps into short text lines through OCR and accessibility labels, then clicks, types, scrolls, and switches windows by name.
- 面向谁：Agent and test authors who need fast desktop workflow control on Linux or Windows without screenshot-heavy loops.
- AI native 点：Converts desktop state into compact agent-readable text and named actions, making GUI control closer to terminal command selection.
- 增长/活跃信号：Pushed 2026-09-24 with 3 stars. Root audit found Cargo files, docs, frames, helpers, packaging, scripts, skill, src, tests, and installers.
- 可运行性判断：Medium-high from Rust package, installers, docs, and tests; no OCR/accessibility scan or desktop click was executed.
- 建议动作：Watch closely for MCP examples and run only against a disposable app until permission and focus-handling are proven.

### 7. [lzc878776-beep/VSManager](https://github.com/lzc878776-beep/VSManager)
- 分类：Visual Studio Copilot orchestration panel
- AI Native Product Score：84
- 做什么：WinForms tool for managing multiple Visual Studio instances, Copilot conversations, debug/build control, task queues, voice summaries, and web remote operations.
- 面向谁：Windows developers coordinating Copilot work across several Visual Studio solutions.
- AI native 点：Treats IDE instances and Copilot chats as an orchestrated multi-agent workbench with task dispatch, waiting, transcript sync, and status readback.
- 增长/活跃信号：Pushed 2026-09-24 with 3 stars. Root audit found many C# source files, solution/project files, settings example, tests, chat/task/debug/remote modules, and detailed Chinese README.
- 可运行性判断：Medium from complete C# project layout; no Visual Studio instance, Copilot pane, debug action, voice path, or web remote was tested.
- 建议动作：Trial on a throwaway Visual Studio solution and confirm task queues never send instructions to the wrong project.

### 8. [ManoloRemiddi/augmentor-agent](https://github.com/ManoloRemiddi/augmentor-agent)
- 分类：Desktop and browser harness for local agents
- AI Native Product Score：83
- 做什么：Desktop and browser agent surfaces sharing a local prompt library, harness adapters, services, docs, release assets, packages, and tests, with DSH as the main target.
- 面向谁：Users standardizing local agent desktop/browser workflows across harnesses such as DSH and Pi.
- AI native 点：Moves agent prompts, harness adapters, and desktop/browser control into a versioned local product rather than loose launcher scripts.
- 增长/活跃信号：Pushed 2026-09-23 with 6 stars. Root audit found apps, adapters, services, packages, docs, config, scripts, tests, security docs, and source-publication metadata.
- 可运行性判断：Medium from broad app/service/test layout; no desktop app, browser harness, prompt library sync, or DSH/Pi integration was run.
- 建议动作：Keep on watch and require a minimal install/run path plus license review before adopting in a shared workflow.

### 9. [zhaoyijia-web/rag-knowledge-base](https://github.com/zhaoyijia-web/rag-knowledge-base)
- 分类：Transparent enterprise RAG workbench
- AI Native Product Score：82
- 做什么：Chinese enterprise RAG knowledge base with hybrid retrieval, RRF fusion, Qwen reranking, DeepSeek evidence generation, frontend retrieval visualization, backend, docs, and tests.
- 面向谁：Teams evaluating local document QA systems that need retrieval traceability and source-visible answers.
- AI native 点：Makes the RAG chain inspectable by exposing retrieval results, scores, sources, latency, and reranking rather than hiding everything behind a chat box.
- 增长/活跃信号：Pushed 2026-09-23 with 3 stars. Root audit found backend, frontend, rag, retrieval, docs/images, tests, pyproject, uv lock, and .env example.
- 可运行性判断：Medium from full-stack/package/test layout and screenshots; no model, vector index, document ingest, or frontend run was executed.
- 建议动作：Use synthetic documents first and judge whether source attribution survives adversarial or ambiguous questions.

### 10. [jestr-ai/openmage-ai-suite](https://github.com/jestr-ai/openmage-ai-suite)
- 分类：Magento/OpenMage AI suite with MCP
- AI Native Product Score：81
- 做什么：AI suite for OpenMage/Magento 1 with MCP server, admin copilot, storefront assistant, LLM discovery, tests, Packagist packaging, and module docs.
- 面向谁：Operators maintaining older Magento/OpenMage stores who want AI assistance without abandoning the legacy stack.
- AI native 点：Brings MCP and assistant workflows into a real legacy-commerce admin surface instead of a generic chatbot demo.
- 增长/活跃信号：Pushed 2026-09-21 with 3 stars. Root audit found app, docs, tests, Composer metadata, modman packaging, dev files, CI badge, and detailed README.
- 可运行性判断：Medium from PHP package/module structure and tests; no Magento/OpenMage instance, MCP server, storefront assistant, or admin copilot was run.
- 建议动作：Evaluate only on a local demo store and verify permissions before connecting catalog, customer, or order data.

## Watchlist

- [mizchi/jev-test-filter](https://github.com/mizchi/jev-test-filter) — Jev-scored test selection，Score 80。Reads a git diff, scores every test against it with Jev, and emits runner-native filter arguments for Vitest, Jest, Playwright, cargo, Go, and more. 建议：Promote after measuring false negatives on a known change set.
- [ChenneyZhuang/laya-browser-agent](https://github.com/ChenneyZhuang/laya-browser-agent) — Local Laya browser decisions，Score 79。Python project for local browser-agent decisions with Laya as an open-source System 1 model alternative to cloud Jev. 建议：Watch for benchmarks against Jev/browser-use and concrete failure recovery examples.
- [TheAdaply/jev-apply](https://github.com/TheAdaply/jev-apply) — Memory-backed job-application form agent，Score 78。Playwright job-application skill where Jev selects saved facts for Greenhouse/Ashby fields, reads values back, and stops before submission by default. 建议：Keep sensitive: test only with fake profiles and require explicit submit controls.
- [DaizeDong/grokbot-cdp](https://github.com/DaizeDong/grokbot-cdp) — Grok Bot CDP control bridge，Score 77。Python bridge for driving the cloud machine behind a Grok Bot through Chrome DevTools Protocol, with guards, examples, docs, tests, and bilingual READMEs. 建议：Watch only; provider policy and account safety need careful review before any real use.
- [ShreyasDasari/evergif](https://github.com/ShreyasDasari/evergif) — Self-refreshing README demo media，Score 76。Agent-skill-backed Next.js project for keeping README demo GIFs current, with app, demo, examples, skills, tests, and GitHub Actions badges. 建议：Promote after a public project demonstrates a before/after stale demo fix.
- [mithun50/ORCA](https://github.com/mithun50/ORCA) — Agentic marine intelligence platform，Score 75。Marine intelligence platform for Indian waters using natural-language queries, multi-RAG retrieval, n8n routing, evidence-backed answers, backend, frontend, docs, and tests. 建议：Keep in watchlist until live data reliability and domain-risk disclaimers are clearer.
- [hojttaler/Resolvr](https://github.com/hojttaler/Resolvr) — Desktop GraphQL IDE with MCP，Score 74。Cross-platform desktop GraphQL client with persistent tabs, git-friendly collections, environments, flows as smoke tests, schema browser, and built-in MCP server. 建议：Watch for agent examples that prove MCP actions are permissioned and auditable.

## Skip Reasons

- [amitshekhariitbhu/ai-engineering-course](https://github.com/amitshekhariitbhu/ai-engineering-course) — High-star AI education repository, but course/content rather than a runnable AI-native product surface.
- [bsmagalhaes/rendra-design-system](https://github.com/bsmagalhaes/rendra-design-system) — Well-structured design system/boilerplate, but not AI-native despite agent instruction files.
- [Keeperorowner/zcode-oss-complete](https://github.com/Keeperorowner/zcode-oss-complete) — Relevant ZCode community completion fork, but appears derivative and sensitive around provider/runtime reconstruction; kept below Top until provenance and safe runtime use are clearer.
- [AvenueSnowStep/ClaudePanel](https://github.com/AvenueSnowStep/ClaudePanel) — Strong star signal for a desktop Claude panel, but audited root/README showed a very thin Rust app surface with missing referenced preview assets and little workflow evidence.
- [arthurfou/medical-regulation-rag](https://github.com/arthurfou/medical-regulation-rag) — Interesting medical RAG project, but notebook/research shaped and safety-sensitive, with less product surface than today’s transparent RAG workbench pick.
- [jiazz197-cmyk/Project_NBHX_RAGbot](https://github.com/jiazz197-cmyk/Project_NBHX_RAGbot) — Enterprise RAG assistant is product-shaped, but heavily sanitized and lower fresh signal than the selected transparent RAG candidate.
- [cnbillsomeday/wp10-aiagent](https://github.com/cnbillsomeday/wp10-aiagent) — Cloudflare Worker chat app with RAG and skills, but reads like a compact generic chat shell rather than a distinct agent product.
- [mohab1426/Socratiq](https://github.com/mohab1426/Socratiq) — AI classroom concept is promising, but current signal overlaps education/demo SaaS and needs stronger proof of live coaching workflow.
- [MasudAhmed28/RecruitAI](https://github.com/MasudAhmed28/RecruitAI) — Salesforce Agentforce/MCP recruitment demo is relevant but thin and platform-specific, with limited runnable evidence in the audited root.
- [grigortodorov/rag-best-practices](https://github.com/grigortodorov/rag-best-practices) — Useful RAG toolkit/playbook, but more best-practices/library material than an end-user AI-native product.

Type-level skip reasons: pure courses, prompt collections, awesome lists, generated template repositories, design-system boilerplates, notebook-only research demos, thin single-file chat shells, unsafe account/browser/provider automation, and repositories whose only product evidence is a README headline were downgraded or excluded. These type-level reasons are not represented as fake GitHub repositories in JSON.

## 今日建议动作

- Put FluidUse, macos-computer-use-kit, and screenpeek into one local computer-use comparison focused on accessibility permissions, action verification, and failure recovery.
- Treat Jev/Laya projects as decision primitives: compare browser-control, test-filtering, and job-application cases separately instead of adopting them as one category.
- Trial pagebeam on a small stale-docs page because documentation drift repair is a lower-risk way to evaluate agent-generated PRs.
- Keep Visual Studio and provider/CDP control projects isolated in disposable workspaces until project targeting, account safety, and audit logs are proven.
